_comment: Bounds of the planner settings the web accepts (Settings, Trucks, Depots) and the solver field each one feeds. Every range lies inside the solver's Pydantic contract (apps/solver/dispatch_models.py), so a saved value can never make an optimization fail with 422. Checked by apps/solver/tests/test_dispatch.py and apps/web/tests/lib/tenant-settings.spec.ts; the web copy is apps/web/lib/planner-bounds.ts.

searchTimeSec._comment: RECOMMENDED's automatic search time in seconds by solvable stops (stabilization PR7, T1), as the Settings page states it: smallDaySec up to smallDayStops; the first point's seconds up to its stops; straight lines through the points, rounded to whole seconds; the last point's seconds up to largeDayStops; largeDaySec above. Never less than the pre-PR7 schedule (5 s up to 25 stops, 20 s up to 200, 150 s up to 350, 240 s above) for any day size. The solver's own copy is auto_time_limit / TIME_LIMIT_POINTS in apps/solver/dispatch_solver.py: apps/solver/tests/test_dispatch.py checks it against this schedule and these examples for every day size, and apps/web/tests/lib/tenant-settings.spec.ts checks the web copy (apps/web/lib/planner-bounds.ts) and the Settings row.
